safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated mentions only one child vomiting and does not include that the wife was also unwell with vomiting (though it does note no diarrhea in household).
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting that the wife was also vomiting slightly weakens the exposure history and assessment of contagious household gastroenteritis, which could affect counseling on infection control and the clinician’s confidence in a viral/contact-spread source. Management for uncomplicated gastroenteritis is typically unchanged, so direct clinical harm is limited.
